description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Lockheed Martin Rotary & Mission Systems is hiring an early-career Software Engineer to develop real-time signal processing software for its product line. The role works with an Agile team on requirements, architecture and design, implementation, unit testing, integration, and sustainment.
Early-career Radar Software Engineer developing real-time signal-processing software, implementing requirements-based designs, and supporting testing, integration, and sustainment.

Responsibilities:
• In this role, you will have the opportunity to perform real-time signal processing software development in support of our product line
• Additionally, the individual will be working as part of an Agile team with domain experts from Software, Subsystems and Systems Engineering to understand requirements, architecture/design, implement sound solutions, develop unit tests, and support integration and sustainment activities

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent technical discipline with a concentration in computer science courses
• Experience or knowledge of object oriented C++ programming
• Experience with Linux and git source control
• Strong math background
• Must be a US Citizen
• This position will require a government security clearance
• This position is located at a facility that requires special access
• Experience with Software Modeling (UML) and architecture
• Understanding and application of Design Patterns
• Experience with Code Optimization
• Experience with Automated Test tools and Techniques, Static Code Analysis, and Embedded Applications
• Radar Fundamentals
• Digital Signal Processing
• CUDA development
• Experience with Agile Software Development
• Experience with Atlassian tools
